Invitation to tender: Harbour County Council seeks an agency for its recycling awareness campaign. Responses are scored against the scoring criteria: team and personnel 30%, insight and campaign strategy 40%, measurement and reporting 30%. Presentations are limited to 20 slides. Raise household recycling by 8% in 12 months. Reach adults aged 25 to 54 in the county. Avoid the phrase 'zero waste' in all material.
